findings.passage: We must ban not just assault weapons, but guns that can be easily converted into assault weapons and automatics.
findings.note: Campaign issues page, gun safety section (page undated; fetched 2026). Calls for banning assault weapons and guns easily converted to them; also says to ban sale of any weapon that can be converted into a machine gun.
subjects: ban on guns that can be converted

findings.passage: We must eliminate all sales and gun show loopholes and strengthen gun dealer inspections and protocols to ensure that all sellers are following California law.
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Wants gun show and sales loopholes closed and tougher dealer inspections.

findings.passage: We must take on technology before advancements are unstoppable –regulating 3D printed weapons and the use of AI in building and converting weapons of the future;
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Supports regulating 3D-printed guns and AI use in building or converting guns.

findings.passage: To do this, we should expand background checks, red flag laws, programs that prevent domestic violence offenders from being able to purchase weapons; and we should incentivize safe storage programs and protocols.
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Supports more background checks, red flag laws, domestic-violence purchase bars, and safe storage incentives.

findings.passage: California should be a national model for gun safety and training .
findings.note: Campaign issues page. Says California should strengthen licensing and training requirements so anyone buying a gun is prepared to be a responsible owner.
subjects: licence and training to buy a gun

findings.passage: In the State Senate, Brian will lead on this issue…and build coalitions to pass the most effective, comprehensive gun safety laws in America.
findings.note: Campaign issues page. General pledge to lead on gun safety laws; also says he is a longtime supporter of Everytown and Giffords.
